Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Join a project shaping the next generation of electric vehicles for leading German automotive brands.
 As part of an international engineering team, you'll contribute to the validation and quality of cutting-edge infotainment and software platforms, working with automation, diagnostics and complex embedded systems.
 What you'll do
 ✅ Develop and maintain automated test cases using Python and Robot Framework 
 ✅ Execute and analyze automated and manual tests on automotive test benches
 ✅ Investigate issues through log analysis and troubleshooting
 ✅ Work closely with developers, test engineers and integration teams
 ✅ Contribute to improving automation coverage and testing processes
 What we're looking for
 ✔ Strong experience with Python scripting 
 ✔ Hands-on experience with Robot Framework 
 ✔ Software/System Testing background
 ✔ Experience with Git 
 ✔ Log analysis and debugging skills
 ✔ Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
 Nice to have
 ⭐ Automotive testing experience
 ⭐ Infotainment systems exposure
 ⭐ Knowledge of UDS protocol 
 ⭐ Networking fundamentals ( Wireshark, IPv4/IPv6, packet analysis )
 Why join?
 🚗 Work on next-generation EV platforms
 🌍 International engineering environment
 💡 Exposure to complex automotive technologies
 📈 Growth and long-term career opportunities
 🤝 Collaborative and highly skilled teams
 Tech stack: Python | Robot Framework | Git | DLT | ADB | Chipmunk | EsoTrace | Wireshark | Automotive Testing
